scientific.integrity: The proof uses only the source law-of-sines correction in the two-dimensional span of two task gradients. Each ordered correction reaches the source target relative to the other original gradient; composing both ordered corrections yields an exact final mutual-angle formula.
limitations: Single-step target treated as fixed; EMA target dynamics are outside scope.
Target one is a singular endpoint and is used only through a limit.
No empirical-performance or convergence claim is made.

title: Symmetric GradVac has a sharp target-overcorrection phase diagram
